x, y, n = map(float, input().split())

min_error = 1e9
num_result = 0
den_result = 1

for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a_upper = int(math.ceil(b * x / y))
    a_lower = int(math.floor(b * x / y))
    
    error_upper = abs(x / y - a_upper / b)
    if error_upper < min_error:
        min_error = error_upper
        num_result = a_upper
        den_result = b

    error_lower = abs(x / y - a_lower / b)
    if error_lower < min_error:
        min_error = error_lower
        num_result = a_lower
        den_result = b

print(f"{num_result}/{den_result}")
</translated_code>
